Definition: Does the government maintain a digital electoral register?
Comments: Voter registration cards distributed by CENI, digital processes implied but not confirmed fully nationwide.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Original source (a card-collection logistics article) did not actually address digitisation and has been replaced. CENI's own account (26 Dec 2024) describes paper enrolment registers being manually data-entered at a central Centre de Traitement des Données to compile the electoral file, while International IDEA states that no technology is used to capture registration data at polling points. Evidence is mixed between paper-based capture and a centrally compiled digital register, so the Partially deployed vs Under development distinction is genuinely uncertain — flagged for human review rather than asserting a change.

Definition: Does the government maintain a digital land register?
Comments: EDRMS launched June 2025 for land titles and cadastre by DTFCN, part of World Bank Digital Foundations. Partially deployed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed and updated with a stronger, more recent source. Beyond the June 2025 EDRMS (an internal case-management tool for land agents, not a public title register), Finance Law 2025-2026 (effective 1 January 2026) now mandates a secure electronic land title for all property owners, with the initial rollout limited to Bujumbura, Gitega, Makamba and Ngozi and an application deadline of 30 April 2026. This confirms a nationally mandated but only partially rolled-out digital land title system, supporting Value Code 4 (Partially deployed).

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more social protection registers?
Comments: Unified Social Registry (RSU) under development per World Bank Cash for Jobs project, using CORE-MIS/openIMIS.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Score changed from 3 to 4. World Bank and openIMIS sources confirm the CORE-MIS/openIMIS-based social protection register has been operational since May 2025, managing 1.25 million beneficiaries of the Merankabandi Cash for Jobs programme across 5 of Burundi's 18 provinces. A separate Unified Social Registry (USR) that would consolidate all programmes is still under development, but a functioning social protection register already exists and is in active use, supporting Partially deployed (4) rather than Under development (3).

Definition: Is the register integrated with the business register?
Comments: TIN issued automatically during business registration at API/OBR one-stop.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed with better sourcing; the cited Doing Business PDF (a discontinued World Bank product, generic economy profile) did not itself substantiate the specific claim. OBR's own FAQ and independent company-registration guidance both confirm the Tax Identification Number (NIF) is issued by OBR through the API one-stop shop at the point of business incorporation, supporting Partially integrated (4). No evidence found of full, nationwide integration covering informal/unregistered businesses, so 'Fully integrated' is not supported.

Definition: Does the government maintain one or more tax registers?
Comments: eKori system launched 2026 for tax declaration/payment, electronic invoicing, partially deployed.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed but the underlying rationale is corrected. The cited eKori project (kicked off 19 January 2026) is specifically for internal and non-tax revenue collection and is only at project start-up with a 9-phase rollout plan — it is not yet 'launched' for tax declaration/payment or e-invoicing as the original comment stated. However, OBR already operates a separate, functioning digital tax system: the Umutangakori teledeclaration/telepaiement portal for online tax filing and payment, plus the EBMS electronic invoicing system. These confirm a genuinely operational, though not confirmed fully nationwide, digital tax register — still supporting Partially deployed (4), but for different reasons than originally cited.
